description.value: Winskill Aquatic & Fitness Centre is a City of Delta public recreation facility in Tsawwassen offering swimming and fitness amenities. It sits within Delta's broader network of community recreation centres serving the Tsawwassen peninsula. Touring cyclists riding the South Delta routes may find it a useful mid-route stop, though cyclist-specific services are unconfirmed.
